I am trying to get these things out of my head before the afternoon gets busy. The bus ride home yesterday gave me too much time to think about everything I have forgotten recently. That is background, not a request to plan another bus trip. I am not looking for a motivational speech or a new project because these errands do not share a result. Please keep them as four separate tasks in the Inbox. First, add collect the framed photograph tomorrow at 10 am. Second, add email the cycling club tomorrow at 2 pm. Third, add wash the curtains Thursday at 9 am for 45 minutes. Fourth, add buy a replacement mouse Friday at 4 pm. The old mouse keeps disconnecting and the photograph is a gift, but neither detail calls for another task. I already chose the frame and paid for it last week. Do not add those completed bits again. Leave my saved calls and gym sessions alone. These four actions are enough for now, and none is a Must.
Delete the gym task.

I am going to ramble because the little details tend to disappear when I try to sound organised. Yesterday I found an envelope behind the bookshelf and spent a while remembering the exhibition where I bought it. That memory does not need a task and I have already put the envelope away. Today I only want four unrelated things captured. Add call the frame shop tomorrow at 3 pm. Add collect the parcel Thursday at 10 am. Add wash the cushion covers Friday at 9 am for 30 minutes. Add email the chess club next Monday at 2 pm. Please do not invent a project connecting these errands, because there is no shared result beyond getting them done. I am not asking for a new system for my house or another routine. Nothing from my story about yesterday needs to happen again. I just need these four actions saved once, with their own dates, so I can stop rehearsing them while I make tea and get ready for class.
